title: Circular import between two modules
summary: invoice.ts and customer.ts import each other, forming a cycle. It may run today but is fragile to initialisation order and blocks clean layering — the kind of coupling a dependency/architecture gate is meant to surface.
plantedDescription: invoice.ts imports customer.ts and customer.ts imports invoice.ts, creating an A<->B import cycle.
expectedFix: Break the cycle by extracting the shared type/logic into a third module both depend on (e.g. types.ts), or invert one dependency so the import graph is acyclic. Neither module should import the other after the fix.
